def all_cycles(n, L):
    # cycles of length exactly L as frozensets of edges
    cycles = set()
    for combo in combinations(range(n), L):
        # For this vertex set, find Hamiltonian cycles (in K_L structure)
        # Fix first vertex, permute rest

        rest = combo[1:]

            seq = (first,) + perm
            # edges

            for i in range(L):
                a, b = seq[i], seq[(i+1)%L]
                if a > b: a, b = b, a
                edges.append((a,b))
            cycles.add(frozenset(edges))
    return cycles
